name: NGT — Tutor Onboarding Sequence
description: Welcome and onboarding for newly approved tutors.

emails.subject: Welcome to NextGen Tutors — your profile is approved!
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Congratulations — your NextGen Tutors profile has been approved! You are now part of South Africa's growing network of quality, vetted tutors.

Here's how to get started:

  1. Complete your profile: Add a professional photo, detailed bio, and subject specialisations. Login to your dashboard →
  2. Set your availability: Let us know your available hours so we can match you with learners quickly.
  3. Check your email daily: We send new match requests by email. Quick responses get more bookings.

Welcome aboard!

The NextGen Tutors Team

emails.subject: Tips for a standout NextGen Tutors profile
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Tutors with complete profiles receive 3× more booking requests. Here's what makes a great profile:

  • Professional photo: Clear, well-lit headshot with a neutral background
  • Specific bio: Mention your qualifications, teaching approach, and notable results
  • Subject clarity: List every grade and curriculum you're comfortable with (CAPS, IEB, Cambridge)
  • Location details: Specify which suburbs you're willing to travel to for in-person sessions

Update your profile →

emails.subject: Session best practices from our top tutors
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Our highest-rated tutors follow these practices consistently:

  • First session: Spend 15 minutes diagnosing gaps before diving into content
  • Structure every session: Review → Teach → Practice → Preview next session
  • Communicate with parents: A 2-minute summary message after each session builds trust and retention
  • Use past papers: Especially in the final term — it's what parents are paying for
  • Be punctual: Late sessions without notice are the #1 complaint. Set a reminder 30 minutes before.

emails.subject: How and when you get paid
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Here's how payouts work at NextGen Tutors:

  • Payment flow: Parents pay the platform via PayFast after each confirmed booking. You receive your tutor rate directly.
  • Rates: Online sessions: R200/hr · In-person sessions: R250/hr · Tertiary: R350/hr
  • Payout schedule: Payments are processed within 5 business days of the completed session.
  • Disputes: Any billing queries should be sent to billing@nextgentutors.co.za with the session date and learner name.

Questions? Reply to this email — we're here to help.
